freeze_rule: No threshold, boundary, sample count, hard gate, ordering, or branch rule may change after Phase B observations begin.
execution_order: Run adapter-complete sample sets serially in the order in-process, ssh-linux, macos-e06-stub; only an explicitly named fault pair may overlap.

sample_policy.rerun_rule: Retain the failed complete set and restart from sample one only after a documented contract-compatible operational correction; never discard individual samples.

timing_metrics.start: Accepted plan, resolved profile digest, complete result identity, and ready immutable result already exist.
timing_metrics.end: Verified immutable artifact handles are returned.

timing_metrics.start: Verified result miss is recorded and a warm compatible worker is available.
timing_metrics.end: The attested worker returns a ready attempt-owned sandbox.

timing_metrics.start: TryReserve enters the provider adapter while worker acquisition is blocked by the harness.
timing_metrics.end: A granted, queued, mismatch, or unavailable disposition returns.

timing_metrics.start: A durable cancel request is accepted.
timing_metrics.end: The cancellation acknowledgement is durably visible.
Execution is stopped and every experiment-owned reservation, sandbox, and session is released, or an exact durable orphan is recorded.

log_replay_rule: From the last acknowledged cursor, reconnect replay is gap-free and duplicate-free by sequence identity and byte-equivalent to the original durable stream.

benchmark_harness.invocation_rule: Invoke the fixture command; never import its Go package into the experiment.
